title: Snake Game
description: A classic Snake game. Arrow keys to move, with walls, pause, and it speeds up as you go.

title: Minesweeper
description: My take on Minesweeper. Left click to reveal a square; right click or Shift+click, to flag it as a mine — with a difficulty picker.

title: Pong
description: A Pong game I originally built for a 2020 online campaign at The Hallway. Arrow keys to move your paddle against the CPU, first to 5 wins — with a difficulty picker.

title: Tetris
description: My take on Tetris. Arrow keys to move and rotate, space to hard drop — with ghost piece, next-piece preview, and levels that speed up as you clear lines.
